EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: retrieves pricingRuleId from the request parameters and auditUserId from the request header. 2. Decisions and branches: invokes ABKOR001.executeDeletePricingRules(pricingRuleId, auditUserId); the library retrieves the pricing rule by ID, adds advice ABKO10000405 and returns if it does not exist, validates that the rule is active and that its status is SYC, and propagates ABKO10000410 or ABKO10000409 as advice when either validation fails. 3. Invoked libraries and methods: when validation leaves no advice, the library gets the next audit ID, inserts the audit record, and deactivates the pricing rule by updating its status to PAD. 4. Errors and subsequent actions: if the deactivate update affects no rows, the library throws ABKO00000010 and converts it into advice; after the library call, the transaction sets severity EWR when the advice list is not empty. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: the transaction does not assign output parameters.

Accessed Libraries.Description: Deletes the requested pricing rule by retrieving it, validating that it is active and in SYC status, registering the audit operation, and updating its status to PAD.

Error Management.Description of the error situation: Pricing Rule with id: %s not found
The pricing rule with id %s is inactive and cannot be deactivated
Only rules in state SYC can be deactivated.
No se pudo desactivar la regla en la base de datos.

Input Parameters.Description: Identifies the pricing rule to retrieve, validate, audit, and deactivate.
